completionEvidence.description: The Go integration test created a qcow2 overlay, started QEMU/WHPX, reached the guest login prompt and stopped through QMP system_powerdown.
A second StartVm returned the original PID instead of launching another QEMU process; a second StopVm returned stopped without error.
The same test also created and restored the go-integration qcow2 snapshot and deleted the VM.

notes: PowerState and GuestHealth are separate fields in vm.json. The provider also needed an explicit QEMU -L data directory so VNC keymap loading does not depend on the caller working directory.
